note: Consensus of four public boards: Tankathon (updated 2026-09-10), Daily Faceoff (July), The Hockey Writers (Sep 7) and The Hockey News tiers (Sep 18). Score = average rank across sources; missing lists count as 40. EliteProspects blocks automated access, so its lists aren't included.

players.name: Landon DuPont
players.note: Former WHL exceptional-status D who jumped from 60 to 73 points and won the WHL title, now at Michigan. Every source has him No. 1. He runs a power play, blocks shots and competes. The dream fantasy D: elite Pt-D and STP with strong Corsi.

players.name: Nazar Privalov
players.note: 6'4" 227 lb MHL rookie of the year (30 goals). Physical and skilled, a rare banger with a scorer's touch. That's a perfect fit for our Hit/PIM + G/SOG mix. The KHL contract could delay his arrival.

players.name: Sergei Skvortsov
players.style: Skilled two-way winger, high hockey IQ
players.note: 43 points in 52 MHL games, and he scored his first KHL goal at 17 in September 2026. Elite hands and reads, relentless motor. Needs to add strength. Projects as a points-and-possession winger.

players.name: Carter Meyer
players.note: Left the NTDP for the QMJHL's Quebec Remparts, with Boston University expected in 2028-29. He hits everything and has a wicked release. A rare multi-category forward (Hit + G + Tk).

players.name: Alexis Joseph
players.note: 60 points as a QMJHL rookie, plus 13 in 5 games at the U17 World Challenge. Big-body net-front scorer with physicality. The skating isn't explosive, but he projects for category volume (SOG, Hit, goals).

players.name: Dima Zhilkin
players.note: 75 points and 100 PIM as Saginaw's 17-year-old captain, and dominated the U18 Worlds. PIM + Hit + points is gold in our format, so a fantasy riser.

players.name: Sammy Nelson
players.note: 54 points in 58 games for the NTDP; missed the 2026 cutoff by four days. Now at Notre Dame. High shot generator with strong details, so good SOG and Corsi.

players.name: Brock England
players.note: 20+ goals and 50+ points as a WHL rookie. The best skater among his peers (THW), with two goals in the Hlinka final. Turnover-forcing speed suggests Tk upside.

players.name: Jonah Neuenschwander
players.note: Swiss World Junior player at 15. 12 points in 32 NL games is the best by a Swiss draft-1 player in 60 years. Dominant at the Hlinka. Size + shot suits category leagues.

players.name: Milan Sundström
players.note: Son of Niklas Sundström. Point per game in Swedish U18 and U20. Classic Swedish two-way center, strong in Tk and Cor.

players.name: Jaxon Jacobson
players.note: 85 points (60 assists) in 63 WHL games; missed the 2026 cutoff by three months. Assist machine who could anchor a PP.

players.name: Brock Cripps
players.note: 37 points as a WHL rookie plus 21 in 20 playoff games, and a shorthanded goal at the Hlinka. Mostly Pt-D value. Size may push him down draft boards.

players.name: Andrei Pustovoy
players.note: 32 goals and 62 points in the MHL; a late-2008 birthday. Heavy shot and a PP one-timer.

players.name: Timothy Kazda
players.note: 41 points in 59 USHL games, and tied for the U18 Worlds scoring lead with 12 points. Moved to the OHL's Guelph Storm. Dangerous skill, mostly offense.

players.name: Luca Santala
players.note: Nearly a goal per game internationally for Finland U18, now with the OHL's London Knights. Excellent shot, not physical.

players.name: Bosse Meijer
players.note: 25 points in 13 U20 playoff games led the league. Viggo Björck-like profile. Could push up draft boards with SHL time.

players.name: Yevgeni Yakunin
players.note: About 50 points in the MHL. KHL contract with Spartak through 2031, so a long wait. Dynasty stash only.

players.name: Petr Tomek
players.note: 20 points in 51 games in Czechia's top league at 16; the other seven Czech D-1 players combined for one point. Excellent skater and thinker. A floor-first profile.

players.name: Jaakko Wycisk
players.note: 43 points in 60 OHL games; one of Canada's most consistent players at the Hlinka.

players.name: Noah Davidson
players.note: 30 goals and 52 points as a WHL rookie. Big, physical scorer with a heavy shot and a Boston College commit. Strong Hit + G fantasy blend.

players.name: Levi Harper
players.note: 57 points as an OHL rookie D. Shoots a lot, and the defense is still raw. A classic fantasy-over-real D.

players.name: Kohyn Eshkawkogan
players.note: 53 points in 68 OHL games; Penn State commit. Undersized.

players.name: Boston Tait
players.note: 23 points and 55 PIM on a bad Wenatchee team. Physical and gets pucks to the net. A banger-D profile that suits Hit/Blk/PIM.

players.name: Vladimir Shtyrkhunov
players.note: 32 MHL points at 16, now in the QMJHL (Shawinigan). Needs size.

players.name: Malik L'Italien
players.note: QMJHL All-Rookie. Defensive-first with a good first pass.

players.name: Max Calce
players.note: Top young German forward, already playing DEL minutes with Mannheim.

players.name: Douglas Johnsson
players.note: Superb numbers at every Swedish level. Size is the question.

players.name: Diego Gutierrez
players.note: NTDP defender built for the modern game: gap control and rushes. Pt-D and Corsi type.

players.name: Nolan Fitzhenry
players.note: Electric with the NTDP U17 team and has a great shot.

players.name: Jamie Glance
players.note: Much of what he does doesn't show on the scoresheet: forces giveaways and draws penalties. THW calls him a sleeper. Tk-leaning fantasy fit.

players.name: Ryerson Edgar
players.note: Just under 50 points as an OHL rookie. Strong defensively for his age.

players.name: Roberts Naudins
players.note: Huge frame; moved to the WHL's Penticton Vees.

players.name: Tomas Selic
players.note: Slovakia's standout at the U18s and the Hlinka.

players.name: Shaeffer Gordon-Carroll
players.note: Role expanding with the Ruck twins in Medicine Hat.

players.name: Gavin Burcar
players.note: Consistent shot generator at the Hlinka. 7 goals and 17 points last season, so a big jump is expected.

players.name: Dorian Eklund Aspe
players.note: Imposing frame with skill and a burst of speed.
